steps.body: To add tenths and hundredths, rename first: turn the tenths into hundredths, then add the counts.
steps.narration: To add tenths and hundredths, rename first: turn the tenths into hundredths, then add the counts.

widget.prompt: Shade the grid to show 0.25. Each full column is one tenth; each cell is one hundredth.

commonCounts.feedback: That adds just one cell. The 0.05 being added is 5 hundredths — five cells on top of the 20 already shaded.

widget.successFeedback: 20 given cells plus 5 more — 25 hundredths in all: 0.2 + 0.05 = 0.25.
widget.lowFeedback: The shaded amount is still below the target. Fill whole columns for the tenths digit first, then single cells for the hundredths.
widget.highFeedback: The shaded amount has gone past the target. Each full column is one tenth — check the tenths digit before adding single cells.

predict.prompt: Two full columns (0.2) are already shaded. After adding 0.05 — five more cells — what will the total be?
predict.reveal: 0.2 is 20 hundredths. Adding 5 hundredths makes 25 hundredths: 0.25. Adding the digits 2 + 5 as if they shared a place would wrongly give 0.7.

widget.prompt: Add 0.2 + 0.05. Write the sum as a decimal.

commonErrors.feedback: That adds the digits 2 and 5 as if both were tenths, but the 5 in 0.05 sits in the hundredths place. Rename 0.2 as 20 hundredths first, then add.
